newsitem.title: JORDAN: Germany's Kinkel meets King Hussein in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel meets King Hussein in Jordan.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel met King Hussein of Jordan on Tuesday at the start of a visit during which he will discuss the Middle East peace process and economic assistance to Jordan.
Kinkel, accompanied by a team of businessmen and finance officials, did not speak to reporters on arrival at Amman airport or at the king's palace.

A Jordanian government official said Kinkel would discuss "the peace process and the dangers it is facing" after Israel's decision last week to build Jewish settlements in Arab East Jerusalem, a move which provoked international criticism.
Kinkel would also discuss German financing of water projects in Jordan, including a joint project with Israel. He is due to leave Jordan on Wednesday to visit Israel and Palestinian-ruled Gaza.
